rows.name: Ledger hardware wallet
rows.reason: Cryptocurrency custody and signing hardware does not provide the member savings, lending, banking operations or general accounting ledger required to run this credit union.

rows.name: Cyclos 3.6
rows.reason: Cyclos 3.6 supports accounts/balances, payment authorizations/scheduling and loans. General ledger/external banking need verification. Cyclos 3 unmaintained; mission-critical deployment discouraged. Historical candidate, not an unqualified current recommendation.

rows.name: Mifos X
rows.reason: Mifos X documents lending, accounting and savings; exact 2014 configuration, payments and deployment sizing remain unverified. Proprietary M-Pesa integration cannot establish support; repayment/accrual evidence postdates the question.

rows.name: QuickBooks Online
rows.reason: Proprietary subscription accounting fails the explicit open-source requirement; its limited license restricts modification and redistribution despite relevant bookkeeping and payment-recording functions.

rows.name: Ledger hardware wallet
rows.reason: Crypto-key wallet and portfolio app do not supply a whole credit-union banking/payment/ledger system. Shared naming establishes no relationship; no narrower crypto-custody component was requested or mapped.

rows.name: S.A.F.E. Open Source Microfinance Suite
rows.reason: Microfinance suite combines lending, cash handling, savings and accounting. June 2014 notes warn of difficult configuration/partial English; later module lists cannot establish all modules existed in 2014.

rows.name: OpenCBS Desktop
rows.reason: OpenCBS Desktop supports clients, loans, repayments and savings with separate accounting/payments. Availability before 2014-09-15 is unestablished; files date 2016–2017. Desktop became unsupported after Cloud replaced it in 2019.

rows.name: Mifos
rows.reason: Open-source core banking covers savings, loans, transfers and accounting; dated 2014 release evidence establishes availability before the cutoff, although payment-network integrations require evaluation.

rows.name: QuickBooks Online
rows.reason: QuickBooks Online conflicts with required open-source licensing because platform terms restrict reproduction, modification and redistribution/licensing. Accounting/bank feeds do not override this; the conclusion does not rely on pricing.

rows.name: Mifos X
rows.reason: Mifos X supports open-source savings, lending, transfers and accounting. External payment-network connectivity and local reporting require evaluation; a 400–1,000-member installation was not tested.

rows.name: GnuCash
rows.reason: Covers double-entry accounting only if separate member-account/payment systems are chosen. Evidence supports personal/small-business accounting, not an all-in-one credit-union core or multiuser teller/payment-processing deployment.

rows.name: OpenCBS Desktop
rows.reason: OpenCBS Desktop's open-source loans/savings/repayments leave free-core ledger unresolved. Desktop development spans 2013–2017; 14.11 manual date unknown. Cloud features do not establish Desktop support; throughput/external clearing unverified.

rows.name: Mifos
rows.reason: Retain Mifos X open-source platform/community app: dated lending/savings/accounting evidence; current site targets small institutions. Exact payment configuration/question-date release coverage unverified; complete deployment unestablished.

rows.name: Cyclos 3
rows.reason: Cyclos 3 only: open-source accounts/payments/loans, but institutional ledger and 400–1,000-member release suitability unverified. Unmaintained; mission-critical use discouraged. Maintenance is a material caveat, not a required exclusion.
